deliveroo.source: sales: Deliveroo Weekly Brand Report (GBP 1 rounding); orders: Deliveroo Daily Master delivered, Mon-Sun + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Covers rose by 176 (8.79%) week on week and spend per head fell by £1.09; Trang put the lower spend down to the Monday to Thursday £5 ramens and fake email vouchers generated through third party platforms, and the report cites app vouchers.
Sales rose by £291.26 (0.69%) week on week and were £6,542.92 (18.43%) above target, with high sales Wednesday to Sunday; sales without discounts were £48,585.84.
Labour was 25.85% (22.36% without discounts), with Monday and Tuesday less busy; Ziang Lin and Kaitlin Docherty reviewed Saturday labour, shown at 20% on the dashboard.
Food cost was 19.43% because order placement for deliveries from JFC and Arrow was missed.
Delivery value reached about £2,100 and prep time fell by one minute, but late prepared orders rose because of weekend busyness.
Google rating was 4.8, with 49 five star, four 4 star, three 2 star and one 1 star review; the 1 star was a walkout at a busy Sunday lunch over table availability and queue management.
Maintenance: drainage cleaning, door stoppers, the Zen pest job, the ramen section leak and the draft beer issue are solved; the VIP leakage is still pending, high priority, with Francheska.
Staffing: kitchen assistant Marciano has left (P45); Anik has joined as a new kitchen placement; part time FOH recruitment is open.
FOH and BOH deep cleaning has started, and the team agreed to set up a weekly deep cleaning checklist for Soho.
The site could not change item prices and unit quantities on the Brakes invoices in the system and will contact Ross, as advised by Kei Cannon.

Ziang Lin advised a structured floor plan at peak weekend shifts, with six staff covering set sections, the door and table resetting, so cover holds during breaks, comparing it to Noodle Inn's fast turnover model.
Upcoming: frozen ramen for students, 50% off first Slerp orders over £20, and the Halloween event and decor.
Areas for improvement: deep cleaning for FOH and BOH, and labour cost control.
Ziang Lin and Kaitlin Docherty plan to swap sites at the end of the month, with Ziang Lin working in Soho three days a week and Kaitlin Docherty covering Shoreditch and Southampton.

Region: the team aligned on implementing and keeping the dry ice presentation standard for volcano rolls and sashimi across sites: dry ice is poured at the table in a circular shape for volcano rolls, and sashimi is served on crushed ice in a red vegan ramen bowl with bamboo leaves and daikon to reduce dry ice waste.
